name: Mercure Cibadak Sukabumi Resort
short_description: A 99-room nature resort near Nagrak, Sukabumi, with treehouse-style rooms, four pools, and a bird aviary, opened February 2026.
ai_summary: Mercure Cibadak Sukabumi Resort opened on 1 February 2026 on Jalan Raya Nagrak in Kabupaten Sukabumi, West Java, about 5 km from the Parungkuda toll exit and 2 km from Cibadak train station. The 99-room property includes distinctive treehouse-style villas alongside Classic, Privilege, Privilege Luxe, and Suite rooms, set among Sukabumi's forested landscape with Mount Salak views. Facilities include four swimming pools (with a dedicated kids' pool), a Devaloka restaurant, spa, fitness center, bird aviary, and an activity center, plus a 198 sqm ballroom and a 216 sqm chapel for weddings. As a newly opened resort, it positions itself as a gateway to nearby Situ Gunung's suspension bridge and Pelabuhan Ratu beach. Early guest reviews describe it as new, clean, and well-suited to families.

faqs.question: When did Mercure Cibadak Sukabumi Resort open?
faqs.answer: It opened on 1 February 2026, on Jalan Raya Nagrak in Kabupaten Sukabumi, West Java, about 5 km from the Parungkuda toll exit and 2 km from Cibadak train station. As a newly opened property, its guest-review track record is still building, though early reviews describe it as clean and family-friendly.

faqs.question: Does Mercure Cibadak Sukabumi Resort have treehouse rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside Classic, Privilege, Privilege Luxe, and Suite rooms, the resort's 99 accommodations include distinctive treehouse-style villas set among Sukabumi's forested landscape, with views toward Mount Salak from several room categories.
